rule: Per group (P single plants, D benign edits, K markups) the third of variant ids with the lowest sha256("tough-eval-heldout-v1:"+id) is held out. C00, B00 and the M variants stay in development. Held-out variants are run but never scored or inspected until the final comparison (compare.mjs --split heldout --final). Version 2 adds the long bundle with the same rule per group (BA annex plants, BD annex benign edits, BL length-paired agreement plants, BK bundle markups); the version 1 assignments are unchanged.
